approach: Append two [[default]] entries to defaults.toml (version-pins, hermetic-checks). Each first sentence states the stance, because DefaultsModel::render (crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs:58-72) prints only first_sentence(statement), cut at the first ". " (defaults.rs:77-83). Raise BudgetSet::Reader from 2_000 to 2_200 (crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs:176) and the literal `of 2000` at crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs:1625 to `of 2200`. Add one unit test in defaults.rs that parses the real defaults.toml (REPO_DEFAULTS, defaults.rs:89) and asserts both ids, the key phrases and the rendered reader lines. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` to read the computed reader size, then set the `budget reader:` line of docs/system-facts.md (line 25) to that size and 2200. Append decision D181 to docs/decisions.md (D180 starts at line 5198 and the log ends at line 5225), add a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased/Added, and reword the budget comment in lib.rs:177-179. Nothing else changes. Revision: criterion 8 now names its seam (the two recorded check commands, run on the final tree, no double; the seam exists) and what fails without it (an unformatted or lint-warning change makes `cargo fmt --all --check` or `cargo clippy ... -D warnings` exit non-zero). The rest of the plan is as in round 1, with two citations corrected.

decisions.choice: Put the stance in the first sentence of each new entry, with detail after it, and keep '. ' out of that sentence.
decisions.reason: render() prints only the first sentence (defaults.rs:77-83). The reader sees nothing past it, so a pin or ambient-tool rule in a later sentence would not reach it and the reader would ask again. The producer and verifier get the full statement through get() (defaults.rs:51-53, doc at 55-57).

rejected.option: Put the full policy in one long first sentence
rejected.why: It costs reader tokens for no gain; the producer and verifier already see the full statement.

decisions.choice: Raise the reader budget to 2_200 and record the measured size in docs/system-facts.md line 25.
decisions.reason: The reader set is 1998 of 2000 (docs/system-facts.md:25). The two entries add about 165 tokens (the earlier producer measured 2163, an estimate). The facts line must equal the computed value or `system_facts_budgets_match_computed` fails (crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs:124-129, message at 109-113). The producer reads the exact size from that failure message and writes it.

rejected.option: Shorten other defaults or prompts/reader.md to fit 2000
rejected.why: It makes this job edit other policy text and prompt files, which are out of scope; the request names a budget raise.

rejected.option: Derive the figure in run_pin_tests.rs from BudgetSet::Reader.budget()
rejected.why: Criterion 3 asks for the line to carry the same figure. A literal keeps the pin and the test fails on drift.

decisions.reason: The only version check is `version >= 1` (defaults.rs:94 in the test; DefaultsModel::parse at defaults.rs:36-49 checks only parse, duplicate ids and empty text). A version bump is a separate decision the brief does not ask for.

rejected.why: Not required or requested, and it has its own side effects on proposals built against a named base version.

decisions.choice: Test the rendered reader prompt through DefaultsModel::render in athena-data, in the existing `mod tests` of defaults.rs.
decisions.reason: The data crate is a leaf and cannot reach context (system-facts crate list). render() is the exact text composed into the reader's defaults component (run_pin_tests.rs:1629-1635 composes `DefaultsModel::parse(include_str!("../../../defaults.toml")).render()`). Existing tests in this module pin render lines the same way (defaults.rs:128-145).

decisions.choice: Reword the comment at lib.rs:177-179 ('A budget never rises to fit a set').
decisions.reason: The comment sits in the Producer and Verifier arms, next to a Reader arm that now rises. Reword it to apply to those two budgets and to say the reader's rose for the defaults it must carry (D181).

rejected.why: A reader of the code would see a contradiction.

decisions.choice: Answer round-1 findings 1 and 2: the criterion 8 demonstration names fails_without and a seam.
decisions.reason: Seam: the production entry points are the two checks Athena records, `cargo fmt --all --check` (rustfmt over every workspace member) and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (`--all-targets` compiles the `#[cfg(test)]` module of defaults.rs, so the new test is linted). The fixture is the final working tree, injected by running in the working directory. No double and no flag are used. The seam exists today: both commands are in the checks list and the verifier's command list, and no plan step adds it. fails_without: a tree whose new test is not rustfmt-formatted makes fmt exit 1 with a diff, and a tree whose new test or edited lines carry a clippy warning makes clippy exit non-zero under `-D warnings`.

rejected.option: Treat criterion 8 as content and give no seam
rejected.why: The brief tags it [behavior], and Athena requires a seam and fails_without for every behavior criterion.

rejected.option: Add a test that shells out to cargo fmt or clippy
rejected.why: It puts the check inside a test and adds code for no gain, since the recorded checks already run these exact commands.

steps: Read defaults.toml (the last entry, `thrash-stop`, ends at line 103). Append `version-pins`. The first sentence of its statement is like: "Version pins are exact and never auto-floated; only the person running Athena bumps one, through one explicit command that sets the pin to the installed version." A second sentence names the scope (code, config, build) and why. applies_to is ["code", "config", "build"]; source is "jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q: the reader asked about pin policy". Use no '. ' inside the first sentence.

Append `hermetic-checks` the same way. The first sentence is like: "A check never depends on the inherited environment or ambient tools: the runner passes every path a check needs explicitly, and any preferred-versus-fallback tool choice is recorded in the check output." applies_to is ["code", "build", "tests"] and the source is the same style, citing both jobs. Do not touch `version = 1`.

In crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs `mod tests`, add `repository_defaults_carry_pin_and_hermetic_policy`. It parses REPO_DEFAULTS, calls get() for both ids and unwraps, and asserts applies_to of version-pins is [code, config, build]. It asserts the statements contain `exact`, `never auto-floated` and `ambient`. It asserts model.render() contains each id's `- id [classes]: ` line with its first sentence and does not contain a marker from the second sentence. Lay out long string literals as in the existing assertions at defaults.rs:133-135.

In crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs change `BudgetSet::Reader => 2_000` (line 176) to 2_200. Reword the comment at lines 177-179: it keeps Producer and Verifier near their largest set, and it says the reader's budget was raised in D181 for the two new defaults.
In crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs line 1625 change `of 2000 tokens used` to `of 2200 tokens used`.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`. It fails with the computed reader size if docs/system-facts.md is stale. Set line 25 to `  - budget reader: <N> of 2200`, where N is the figure in the message. Re-run until it passes. Change no other line of that file.

Append D181 to the end of docs/decisions.md in the D180 format (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance). Case: the reader asked pin and ambient-tool questions in jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q. Decision: root cause is defaults.toml silence on pin and ambient-tool policy; add the two defaults and raise the reader budget from 2000 to 2200. Provenance names those jobs, the retry of 20261030-060852-dy62, the measured reader size, and the stale design-doc row (docs/design/context-engineer.md:54) left alone. Do not edit any earlier entry.

Add one bullet at the top of `## [Unreleased]` / `### Added` in CHANGELOG.md. It names the root cause (defaults silent on pin and ambient-tool policy), the two ids, the budget move 2000 to 2200 with the measured size, and the tests `cargo test -p athena-data repository_defaults_carry_pin_and_hermetic_policy` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.

Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Confirm `git diff --stat` shows only the seven deliverable files. These are the commands criteria 5, 7 and 8 observe.

risks.risk: The reader set could land above 2200 if the entries are long. Only the first sentence is rendered, but the id, class list and line prefix also count.
risks.mitigation: Keep each first sentence under about 200 bytes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` after editing defaults.toml. The earlier measurement was 2163 (an estimate), so about 37 tokens of headroom remain.

risks.risk: The facts-file line is off by one, so `system_facts_budgets_match_computed` fails.
risks.mitigation: Step 6 reads the computed figure from that test's failure message and writes it, so the line is not guessed.

risks.risk: A first sentence containing '. ' (an abbreviation such as 'e.g. ') is cut short in the reader's view and the stance is lost.
risks.mitigation: The new test asserts the rendered line contains `exact` and `never auto-floated` (and `ambient` for the hermetic entry), so a cut sentence fails the test.

risks.risk: decisions.md or CHANGELOG.md is edited in the middle, not appended or inserted at the top of Unreleased/Added. Both files are very large.
risks.mitigation: Append D181 after the last line of decisions.md and insert one bullet after the `### Added` line of Unreleased (line 10). The criterion 4 diff shows only additions.

risks.risk: The new test or the edited lines fail the recorded fmt or clippy checks (criterion 8), for instance a long string left on the assert line.
risks.mitigation: Step 9 runs `cargo fmt --all` before the checks and then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. The test copies the layout of the existing render assertions at defaults.rs:133-135.

risks.risk: Raising the reader budget contradicts the code comment that a budget never rises.
risks.mitigation: The rule is in a comment only. The comment is reworded, and D181 records why the reader's budget rises: the defaults it must carry grew.

demonstrations.method: On the final tree, after step 9's `cargo fmt --all`, run `cargo fmt --all --check`, then run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` as a second command. These are the same two commands Athena records as the fmt and clippy checks, so the recorded checks on the final tree count too.
demonstrations.observes: `cargo fmt --all --check` exits 0 with no diff, and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` exits 0 with no warnings. `--all` covers every workspace member, including the edited defaults.rs, lib.rs and run_pin_tests.rs. `--all-targets` compiles the `#[cfg(test)]` code, so the new test is linted. `--locked` holds because the plan adds no dependency.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the change were left unformatted (for example the long `render().contains("- version-pins [...]: ...")` string kept on the `assert!` line instead of on its own line as at defaults.rs:133-135), `cargo fmt --all --check` exits 1 and prints a diff. If the new test or the edited code carried a clippy warning (an unused binding, a needless borrow, an unused import), `cargo clippy ... -D warnings` exits non-zero. Both would fail the recorded fmt and clippy checks.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points: rustfmt through `cargo fmt --all --check` and clippy through `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. They are the commands behind the recorded checks `fmt` and `clippy` (Checks Athena will run). The fixture is the producer's final working tree, injected by running the commands in the working directory; there is no double, flag or env setting. Preconditions: step 9 has run `cargo fmt --all`, Cargo.lock is unchanged and the tree builds. The seam exists today (both commands are in the verifier's allowed list); no step adds it.
